title: 第17章 灵乌
content_zh:
韩榆打开门，便是一愣。

    李老道的灰色衣袍上满是血渍，神色萎靡，眼窝深陷，比平时更加狼狈。

    “道爷，你这是怎么了？”

    “遇上穷鬼劫道了！”李老道一脸恼火地说，“我才拿出三只偷灵鼠，换了六斤灵米，就有人不安好心，想要劫我！”

    韩榆越发惊奇：“什么人干这种事？杂役弟子？”

    “那倒不是，是青禾坊市一个无门无派的散修，带着两个会武功的凡人；我之前购买凡人打的猎物，大概也是被他们注意上了，觉得我不是有实力的，这一次见我有灵米，就想在坊市之外下手抢夺。”

    “早知道青禾坊市内也未必太平，没想到我这么穷困了，还能有穷鬼来劫道。”

    “真是晦气！”

    李老道骂骂咧咧说着，同时扔给韩榆一个小布袋，里面是四斤灵米。

    “给你，两只偷灵鼠，四斤灵米。”

    韩榆接过之后便把灵米放到一旁，询问李老道：“道爷，你是怎么回来的？那三个人……”

    “都杀了！”

    李老道杀气腾腾地说。

    “他们也没料到，我既是厮混多年的武林中人，还有血滴子、嗜血术这等法术。”

    “杀他们颇费一番力气，可惜除了一点凡俗金银之外，什么也没得到。”

    韩榆心想那的确是不可能得到什么有价值的东西——那散修无门无派，连几斤灵米都要抢，自然是穷到不能再穷的“穷鬼”。

    “那散修的修炼功法也没有？”

    “没有。”李老道说，“咱们得到宗门玉简传心法，也不可能带在身上。那种散修更是把心法看做传家宝，肯定会隐藏更深。”

    又莫名地咂嘴：“太可惜了，如果不是距离青禾坊市很近——”

    韩榆听他这话，顿时心内一惊。

    难道，道爷连这也……

    李老道也意识到自己失言，利用别的精血修炼，至少他还能正常跟韩榆来往；一旦开始用人的精血，两人关系必然难再融洽。

    随后转移了话题：“今天有没有人来咱们灵田打听偷灵鼠的事情？若是有的话，十有八九就是那豢养偷灵鼠的幕后盗贼。”
content_en:
Han Yu opened the door and was stunned.

Li Laodao's gray robe was covered with blood stains, his expression was sluggish, his eye sockets were sunken, and he was even more embarrassed than usual.

"Master Dao, what's wrong with you?"

"I've been robbed by a poor man!" Li Laodao said with an annoyed look, "I just took out three spirit-stealing rats and exchanged them for six kilograms of spirit rice, and someone with bad intentions wants to rob me!"

Han Yu became more and more surprised: "Who would do such a thing? A handyman disciple?"

"That's not true. He is a casual cultivator from Qinghefang City with no sect and two mortals who know martial arts. I bought the prey hunted by mortals before, and they probably noticed it. They felt that I was not powerful. This time they saw that I had spiritual rice, so they wanted to rob it outside of Fang City."

"I had known that there might not be peace in Qinghefang City. I didn't expect that I would be so poor and a poor ghost would come to rob me."

"What bad luck!"

Li Laodao cursed and threw a small cloth bag to Han Yu, which contained four kilograms of spiritual rice.

"Here you go, two spirit-stealing rats and four pounds of spirit rice."

After taking it, Han Yu put the spirit rice aside and asked Mr. Li: "Master Tao, how did you come back? Those three people..."

"Kill them all!"

Li Laodao said murderously.

"They also didn't expect that since I have been in the martial arts world for many years, I also have spells such as blood drops and bloodthirsty."

"It took a lot of effort to kill them, but unfortunately I got nothing except a little earthly gold and silver."

Han Yu thought that it was indeed impossible to get anything valuable - the casual cultivator had no family and no sect, and even wanted to snatch a few kilograms of spiritual rice. Naturally, he was a "poor man" who was extremely poor.

"Then there are no cultivation techniques for casual cultivators?"

"No." Li Laodao said, "We can't carry the inner teachings with us even if we get the jade slips from the sect. Those kind of casual cultivators regard the inner teachings as family heirlooms, so they will definitely hide them deeper."

Then he smacked his lips inexplicably: "What a pity. If it wasn't so close to Qinghefang City -"

Han Yu was shocked when he heard what he said.

Could it be that Master Tao even does this...

Li Laodao also realized that he had made a mistake and used other people's essence and blood to practice. At least he could still interact with Han Yu normally. Once he started using human essence and blood, it would be difficult for the relationship between the two to be harmonious again.

Then he changed the topic: "Has anyone come to our spiritual field today to inquire about the spirit-stealing rats? If there is, nine times out of ten, it is the thief behind the scenes who raises the spirit-stealing rats."
